title: Everyone wants bigger opportunities.
paragraphs:
Everyone wants bigger opportunities.
But the real question is simple:
Are you faithful with the small ones first?

The quiet responsibilities.
The unseen work.
The things no one applauds.

Before the platform…
there was preparation.

Before the promotion…
there was faithfulness.

God often tests the heart
with something small first.
Most people want the next level.

How you handle the little things
quietly shapes what comes next.
“What’s one small responsibility you’re trying to stay faithful in right now?”
